name: fdc3-desktop-poc
description: Enterprise FDC3-compatible desktop interoperability shell built on Electron

scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n "SEARCH,PROFILE,PORTFOLIO,MARKET,PAYMENT,FUNDS,ORDERS,AUDIT,THEME" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,green,red,blue,white,gray,black" "vite --config apps/customer-search/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/customer-profile/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/portfolio-view/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/market-watch/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/payment-action/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/funds-allocations/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/incoming-orders/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/audit-log/vite.config.ts" "vite --config apps/theme-toggle/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run build:shell
scripts.build:apps: concurrently "vite build --config apps/customer-search/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/customer-profile/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/portfolio-view/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/market-watch/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/payment-action/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/funds-allocations/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/incoming-orders/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/audit-log/vite.config.ts" "vite build --config apps/theme-toggle/vite.config.ts"
